evals.prompt: 拆解这个本地竖屏参考视频：按时间讲清镜头、声音、花字和叙事作用，然后给我一版原创的 30 秒素材清单。不要上传视频。
evals.expected_output: A local-only, timestamped evidence timeline followed by an original 30-second beat and asset plan.
expectations: Probes source metadata and reports bounded extraction coverage
Separates visual, audio, text, editing, and interpretation lanes
Does not invent ASR or OCR output when those tools were not run
Adapts mechanisms without copying source expression

evals.prompt: 我导入的视频在画布上是黑的而且没声音，双击预览却能看到。请用这份本地文件仔细判断问题在哪。
evals.expected_output: A staged diagnosis that distinguishes source streams and decode health from application rendering and playback state.
expectations: Checks whether video and audio streams exist before diagnosing
Uses decoded frame evidence to separate source problems from canvas problems
Checks mute, readiness, asset delivery, codec, CORS, and draw path as distinct hypotheses
Does not claim a root cause beyond the evidence
